product.description: După al Doilea Război Mondial ia naştere o nouă ordine globală, în care rolurile principale sunt jucate de două supraputeri – Statele Unite ale Americii şi Uniunea Sovietică. Diferenţele ideologice dintre acestea duc la cursa înarmărilor din Războiul Rece şi la teama de izbucnire a unui conflict nuclear mondial. Restul lumii este atras în sistemul celor două blocuri, astfel că numai câteva naţiuni reuşesc să rămână realmente nealiniate. Conflictul Est–Vest se încheie în 1990, după dezmembrarea Uniunii Sovietice şi, în consecinţă, după prăbuşirea blocului comunist răsăritean. De atunci, lumea este condusă de sisteme economice şi politice în curs de globalizare. Omenirea rămâne încă divizată: naţiunile bogate din Europa, din America de Nord şi din Asia de Est diferă substanţial de naţiunile în curs de dezvoltare ale Lumii a Treia.

# Illustrated History of the World: The Contemporary Era (Vol. 6)

Explore the dramatic shifts of the modern age with *Illustrated History of the World: The Contemporary World (Vol. 6)* by Litera. This volume provides a visually rich and detailed journey through the complex geopolitical landscape that defined the world following the Second World War and into the era of globalization.

## Understanding the Post-War Global Order

This book delves into the pivotal period when a new global order emerged, shaped primarily by the rivalry between two superpowers: the United States of America and the Soviet Union. Discover how ideological differences fueled the arms race of the Cold War and the deep fear of a global nuclear conflict that once threatened civilization.

## The Era of Division and Change

The narrative traces how the rest of the world was caught within the boundaries of these two blocs. While only a few nations managed to remain truly neutral, this volume illustrates the profound economic and political shifts that occurred as the Soviet Union dissolved, leading to the collapse of the communist Eastern Bloc in 1990.

The story moves beyond the Cold War to examine the current global landscape, where economic and political systems are now driven by globalization. The book highlights the continuing disparity between wealthy nations in Europe, North America, and East Asia, and the developing nations of the Global South.

## Why Choose This Illustrated History?

This collection offers a unique perspective on modern history, using illustrations to bring complex geopolitical events, ideological struggles, and the forces of global change to life. It is an essential read for anyone seeking to understand the interconnectedness of contemporary world history.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the main focus of this book?**
A: This book focuses on the history and geopolitical changes of the contemporary world following World War II, detailing the influence of the Cold War, the division between superpowers, and the rise of globalization.

**Q: Who is the author or publisher?**
A: The book is published by Litera.

**Q: Is this a complete history?**
A: This volume provides an illustrated history focusing on the contemporary period, offering visual context to major historical events and global dynamics.
